  • Lead Enrichment Agent

    This agent researches new leads and enriches them with key details.

    This agent provides timely responses to new questions in the IT helpdesk Slack channel.

    This agent researches trends, scripts videos, sets up engagement automation, and compiles everything into a shareable document.

  • Support Email Agent

    This agent drafts customer replies using your knowledge base.

  • Candidate Ranking System

    This agent ranks candidate resumes based on various factors like qualifications, skills, etc.

  • Github PR Slack Notifier

    This agent monitors new pull requests by a specific user and notifies a Slack channel.

    This agent summarizes key points from a Slack thread and appends them to a Google Doc for easy reference.

  • Sales Email Writer

    This agent creates personalized sales emails by automatically pulling information from a website.

  • SEO Blog Writer

    This agent takes a product link and topic, then writes a keyword-focused article.

  • Expense Classifier

    This agent automatically organizes and categorizes expense data.
